brief: Main Battery: A low exterior tracking view reveals Resolute, a dark-gray dreadnought battleship with twin-gun main turrets and a red band around its forward funnel, crossing an open slate-blue sea with low swells, a flat horizon, and thin overcast. Its forward turrets finish training toward a pale-gray cruiser with one raked funnel and a white stripe across its bow, distant on the horizon. The camera holds both ships in the same firing axis. Resolute fires one coordinated main-gun salvo: brilliant muzzle flashes, heavy barrel recoil, and expanding smoke. The camera trembles with the concussion, then steadies as smoke drifts above the deck. Do not show the enemy sinking yet. (Sequence 2 of 3 of "Resolute: Contact, Salvo, Confirmation". BIBLE (use these words for these things, every time): captain_vale = a woman with cropped dark hair, a navy double-breasted coat, and brass binoculars; lookout = a young man with curly black hair, a navy sailor shirt, and a red headset; helmsman = a woman with a blond braid, a navy sailor shirt, and rolled sleeves; bridge = a narrow steel bridge with slanted front windows, a central chart table, and cool overhead lamps; sea = an open slate-blue sea with low swells, a flat horizon, and thin overcast; resolute = a dark-gray dreadnought battleship with twin-gun main turrets and a red band around its forward funnel; enemy_cruiser = a pale-gray cruiser with one raked funnel and a white stripe across its bow; tactical_screen = a small square tactical screen with a thick black bezel and amber graphics. Light and grade: Cold late-afternoon daylight, cool steel-blue shadows, restrained saturation, and warm amber screen light; realistic naval-war-film photography..)

tools.prompt: Create a 15-second cinematic naval-war sequence featuring Resolute's main battery, widescreen 16:9. Realistic naval-war-film photography, cold late-afternoon daylight, overwhelming mechanical force, violent recoil and dense smoke against weathered steel. Five coherent shots preserve vessel identities and spatial orientation, keeping both ships on the same firing axis once the target appears. 0–3 seconds: low exterior wide view, Resolute, a dark-gray dreadnought battleship with twin-gun main turrets and a red band around its forward funnel, crosses an open slate-blue sea with low swells, a flat horizon, and thin overcast; lateral tracking reveals its length. 3–6 seconds: medium-wide forward-deck view, Resolute's forward twin-gun turrets finish training toward a pale-gray cruiser with one raked funnel and a white stripe across its bow, distant on the horizon; a slow lateral slide keeps barrels and target aligned. 6–9 seconds: low wide view along the firing axis, Resolute fires one coordinated main-gun salvo, with brilliant muzzle flashes, heavy barrel recoil and expanding smoke above the steel deck; the camera pushes forward and trembles sharply with the concussion. 9–12 seconds: medium-wide deck view, smoke from Resolute's twin-gun main turrets drifts above the deck against the overcast sky; the camera steadies into a gentle ease back, retaining the distant target on the firing axis. 12–15 seconds: separate wide establishing view of Resolute and the distant cruiser, both afloat beneath the flat horizon, residual haze over the main battery; a brief ease back settles into a final hold with no new action. Sound: sea wash, wind and low engine rumble, one synchronized thunderous main-battery report, metallic recoil and lingering rolling echoes; no speech or music. Hold the readable two-ship composition for the final two seconds. Cool steel-blue shadows, restrained saturation, measured buildup and explosive impact. No sinking, additional salvos, subtitles or text overlays.
